notes: TCP model: MSS 1460, 20-byte TCP/20-byte IP headers, no options, one standalone ACK per data segment, no piggyback/delayed ACK, plaintext, no loss. Captured traffic can differ.
Steady-state network model excludes DNS, TCP options, keepalives, retries, registration and radio framing. Suitable for scenario estimates, not captured carrier traffic.
Response policy: MQTT publisher/broker acknowledgment only.
Subscriber traffic is excluded. TCP/IP headers/ACKs use an explicit model, not captures.
Stream values prefer exact measured references; custom streams/network totals use the disclosed TLS flight model. Setup requires matching references; keepalives remain excluded.
